title: xdrip plus 14 day libre calibration issues
body:
Hello all. I have been experiencing problems with calibrations with weeks settling for 50 or more points of deviation. Yes I have stopped sensor and reset calibrations each time. If I calibrate, the next 5 minutes when the sensor reports data the raw data is accepted and I get two arrows downs. I then get adjusted to the raw values from libre. Conversly, using tomato app the calibration take and I get pretty good values when not using xdrip. I have changed lots of values under calibration in xdrip. Im using miao miao 2 with OOP algorithm to communicate. Using the xdrip build from the feb 19 2020 although I have tried nightl for a while. Here is a screen show. #
![Screenshot_20200221-053101](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/57379893/75027737-147b1300-546d-11ea-8354-db8f77522b53.png)

comments.body: I have a similar experience, but can add the US libre 14 reader seems to always be a bit more accurate than xdrip with OOP algorithm. Facebook is full of similar observations. Just having the ability to scale rather than calibrate would be a definite improvement. Seems the inaccuracy is somewhat consistent over sensor life.

I switched over to tomato. It allows me to calibrate and not use the oop
algorithm. Works great and is accurate. I dont think the instructions are
clear with xdrip with oop yet.
